name: Nishizaki Haruo
source: One of Ryuuga's classmates he causes trouble all the time. The only person able to prevent him from going wild is Mifuyu. When Mizuchi restores Ryuuga's memories she gives Ryuuga guns to give to Haruo and his punk friends to take over the school. The only person he listens to now is Ryuuga.
translation: One of Ryuuga's classmates he causes trouble all the time. The only person able to prevent him from going wild is Mifuyu. When Mizuchi restores Ryuuga's memories she gives Ryuuga guns to give to Haruo and his punk friends to take over the school. The only person he listens to now is Ryuuga.
